<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex4022024-09-1315-30-44" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (II, 118a1–118a3; P547a2-547a4)"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4468">bde bar <abbr>gshegs</abbr> pa'i bstan pa rin po che la 'jug pa'i rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rnam par <lb edRef="inst:4470" n="118a2"/> bshad pa</rs> || byang phyogs kyi rgyud <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">kha ba can gyi ljongs</rs> su byung ba || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma rje btsun dam pa rnams</rs> kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma'i ze 'bru spyi bos len <choice><sic>pas</sic><corr>pa</corr></choice> || lung dang rigs pa'i gtsug lag dam pa rnams la yongs su sbyangs pa'i ngal ba mi dman zhing mi zhan la mi nyung byas pa || <lb edRef="inst:4470" n="118a3"/> rigs pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dge ba can || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3806">shAkya'i dge slong blo gros 'byung gnas</rs> zhes bya ba thub pa'i brtul zhugs la legs par gnas pas rang gi dran pa goms pa spel ba'i brjed byang tsam du nye bar sbyar ba rdzogs ||</seg></TEI>
